summary: GLM-5.3-Flash UD-IQ2_XXS with hybrid linear/sparse attention and plain decoding.
note: Text only; the GLM vision tower is not implemented. Downloads all four target shards; the NextN head is embedded in the same files. Uses automatic host expert placement, BF16 latent caches, one request slot and the tested 227328-token context capacity. Requires the GLM5-Next kernels included with the matching SnowLLM build. Speculative decoding is disabled.
